title: The First Few Tokens Matter: Understanding Chain-of-Thought Controllability
abstract: arXiv:2610.40939v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring is a promising way to oversee increasingly capable agents. It succeeds in part because current models appear limited in their ability to control what they verbalize in their reasoning traces. We investigate the source of this limitation and link it to an entropy collapse in the first few tokens following the opening thinking tag. We exploit this mechanism to recover CoT controllability through two inference-time interventions on initial tokens: prefilling, where even a single token can substantially increase controllability, and banning frequent opening tokens combined with in-context examples, which improves average compliance by 34-41 percentage points across models. translated_title: 最初几个词元至关重要：理解思维链的可控性
translated_abstract: 思维链监控是监督日益强大的智能体的一种有前景的方法。它之所以有效，部分原因在于当前模型在控制其推理轨迹中所表达内容的能力上似乎存在局限。我们研究了这种局限的来源，并将其与思考开始标签（thinking tag）之后最初几个词元的熵坍缩联系起来。我们利用这一机制，通过对初始词元进行两种推理时干预来恢复思维链的可控性：其一是预填充（prefilling）——即使仅填充一个词元也能大幅提升可控性；其二是禁用高频起始词元并结合上下文示例——该方法在不同模型上将平均合规性提高了34-41个百分点。这些干预措施主要恢复了添加型与风格型可控性（添加或转换信息），而抑制型可控性（避免或删除信息）则表现出更多样化的响应，这表明其背后存在不同的底层机制。
tldr: 思维链可控性受限源于思考开始标签后最初几个词元的熵坍缩，通过预填充或禁用高频起始词元等推理时干预可有效恢复可控性。
en_tdlr: CoT controllability is limited by an entropy collapse in the first few tokens after the opening thinking tag, and inference-time interventions such as prefilling or banning frequent opening tokens can effectively recover it.
